# Synthetic CFBD cache fixture

This fixture is wholly invented for automated testing. No team, game, poll,
score, statistic, identifier, timestamp, logo, or other response value was
copied from CollegeFootballData.

The fictional 2098 and 2099 seasons exercise raw cache parsing, consecutive
season prior chaining, preseason polls, FBS and FCS games, completed and
scheduled games, weekly statistics, every ranking model, static JSON
publication, and share-image generation.
